title: Glenn Perry / Soullab — claim-level attribution and epistemic separation
rights: No Perry book or essay body, extracts, or embeddings included. Source links, original summaries, and Soullab choices only.
release_gate: Founder editorial ratification, exact-source authority evidence and corpus-admission review required for Soullab-authored commentary. Separate explicit rights for any Glenn Perry source text.

claims.summary: Perry assigns zodiac signs a symbolic role in describing motives and psychological needs.
claims.unsafe_example: This sign proves the member's need.

claims.summary: Perry uses planets, signs, houses and aspects as different characters, motives, settings and relations in a symbolic narrative.
claims.unsafe_example: A planetary aspect caused the event.

claims.summary: Perry proposes that a horoscope can be contemplated as an evolving personal narrative while also claiming purposive chart structure.
claims.safe_example: Perry proposes an evolving story; Soullab does not presume the chart objectively dictates it.
claims.unsafe_example: Perry rejects every notion of fate or destiny.

claims.summary: Perry distinguishes integration of specific functions from broader individuation and psychological development.
claims.safe_example: Perry differentiates local integration and whole-person individuation...

claims.summary: Perry discusses defenses through a psychodynamic account in which some habitual strategies served a protective function.
claims.safe_example: Perry explores protective functions of defenses...

claims.summary: Perry describes archetypes as capable of many possible manifestations rather than one rigid type.
claims.unsafe_example: Because anything fits, astrology is scientifically proven.

claims.summary: Perry proposes an analogy between zodiacal sequence and lifespan developmental stages, without independent validation of astrological stage correspondence.
The member's reported motives take precedence over any zodiacal hypothesis.
claims.safe_example: Let's begin with what matters to you.
claims.unsafe_example: The chart tells me your real motive.

claims.summary: Symbolic frameworks are optional invitations and must not become the origin of a person's emotions.
claims.safe_example: Would you like a symbolic lens?

claims.summary: No chart may be used to diagnose, predict clinical pathology or assign abuse history.
claims.safe_example: A chart cannot establish that history or diagnosis.

claims.summary: Offer alternatives, including that no astrological interpretation applies.
claims.safe_example: Does either interpretation fit, or neither?
claims.unsafe_example: One of these must be your truth.

claims.summary: Reject claims of objectively fated personal life scripts even where Perry's own writing uses teleological language.
claims.safe_example: Your story can change and the symbol need not apply.
claims.unsafe_example: The chart reveals your assigned destiny.

claims.summary: Compare Perry with Jung and Elemental Alchemy while retaining distinct origins and limiting one-to-one mappings.
claims.safe_example: We can explore a comparison between these two traditions.
claims.unsafe_example: Perry is the scientific foundation of Elemental Alchemy.

claims.summary: Never move members' private stories or Sanctuary records into the wisdom corpus.
claims.safe_example: I won't turn private conversation into shared source material.
claims.unsafe_example: Your private story has been added to MAIA's library.

claims.summary: Original editorial discussion may be proposed separately; protected Perry book and article bodies remain blocked pending suitable rights.
claims.safe_example: We can discuss concepts without storing his books.
claims.unsafe_example: Buying the paperback grants full AI embedding rights.
